candidates.formal_type:
∀ {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field.{u_2} k] [IsAlgClosed.{u_2} k] {G : Type u_3} {H : Type u_4} [inst_2 : Group.{u_3} G]
  [inst_3 : Group.{u_4} H] {V : Type u_5} {W : Type u_6} [inst_4 : AddCommGroup.{u_5} V]
  [inst_5 : Module.{u_2, u_5} k V] [FiniteDimensional.{u_2, u_5} k V] [inst_7 : AddCommGroup.{u_6} W]
  [inst_8 : Module.{u_2, u_6} k W] [FiniteDimensional.{u_2, u_6} k W] {ρ : Representation.{u_2, u_3, u_5} k G V}
  {σ : Representation.{u_2, u_4, u_6} k H W},
  Etingof.IsIrreducibleRep.{u_2, u_3, u_5} ρ →
    Etingof.IsIrreducibleRep.{u_2, u_4, u_6} σ →
      Etingof.IsIrreducibleRep.{u_2, max u_3 u_4, max u_5 u_6} (Etingof.extTprod.{u_2, u_3, u_4, u_5, u_6} ρ σ)

source_text: The external tensor product of irreducible representations of G and H is irreducible over an algebraically closed field of arbitrary characteristic.
